stage2_holdout.why: L1 is only a retrieval test if the query sentence is absent from the record it must retrieve. Measuring on the RAW index instead makes L1 circular - which is exactly what the crashed Wave-3 probe did (Router.build(inv)).

stage3_qs_b.protocol: mechanical leave-one-out over a stride-13 walk of the index, restricted to records that are NOT in any lane gold set and NOT a lane holdout source; the held-out sentence is stripped from routing_text before the router is built, and the strip is positively verified
